name: New Content Detected
description: When a new media file lands in Content-data/, auto-scan and update the asset inventory.

then.prompt: A new file was just added to Content-data/. Scan the Content-data directory, classify the new asset (image/video/audio), identify which artist it belongs to based on the folder name, and insert it into the assets table in agent/mainstay.db. Then confirm: artist name, asset type, and filename.
